jurisdiction: United States; state and sector scope unresolved

excluded: Vendor funds, tax and tips where not platform revenue

margin_formula: CM2 = (recognized net platform revenue - direct delivery - payment fees - attributable support/compliance - measured shared delivery allocation - partner compensation) / recognized net platform revenue
threshold_status: Proposed internal planning floor, NOT a U.S. regulatory threshold

timing.review: monthly finance close and before each proposed commercial change

regulatory.reason: U.S. jurisdiction alone does not identify a regulator, rule or prescribed margin definition. No regulatory margin or capital pass is asserted.

cost_challenge.original_assumption: Treat shared VPS/local inference capacity and founder support as free because there is no incremental provider charge per request.
cost_challenge.objection: This can overstate full service contribution. Shared delivery cost and attributable labor need a documented allocation; a regulator-specific rejection cannot be inferred without an applicable rule.
cost_challenge.revised_basis: Metered compute/storage/requests plus logged support/compliance hours, reconciled to supplier invoices and payroll. Allocate each shared pool once; retain a separate idle-capacity cost center.
cost_challenge.illustrative_rerun: Until measured cost pools exist, show support at 6% of baseline revenue and shared delivery at 12% as explicit assumptions, not live costs.

reconciliation.pricing: Catalog price × quantities is a forecast, not recognized revenue.
reconciliation.finance: Gross margin requires a documented COGS classification; annual prepayments are not automatically one month of revenue.
reconciliation.commissions: Use contract-defined eligible collected net fees, collection/refund timing and attribution; payables are not revenue.
reconciliation.regulatory: A prescribed calculation needs its own sourced rule pack and bridge; never substitute CM2.

partner_policy.draft_terms: For ordinary software only: proposed 10–20% of attributable collected net subscription fees for up to 12 months, no double referral/reseller credit; commission must leave the approved contribution floor. Product-specific terms and financial-sector restrictions take precedence.
partner_policy.eligible_base: Collected software fees less tax, refunds, credits and pass-through amounts; check contract/recognition differences.
partner_policy.timing: After collection and the agreed refund hold; monthly reconciliation with contractual clawbacks and dispute process.
partner_policy.profit_sharing: Share only attributable program contribution under a written agreement. Sharing the partner’s whole-company profit requires a separately negotiated arrangement and auditable access; none is assumed.

zero_dollar_policy: Zero paid-media/directory spend. Founder labor, support, content production, hosting and partner commissions still count in unit economics and CAC.
sales_gate: Remote founder-led sales until repeatable wins. A hire needs a qualified pipeline, retention evidence, expected incremental contribution above fully loaded selling cost, and adequate runway. Physical travel requires documented incremental deal value; no automatic revenue threshold is treated as law.
approval: Recommendations only. Founder approval plus relevant finance/legal/commercial review is required before price, scope, partner terms, withdrawal or capital actions. No execution connector exists in this module.
